performance_case.claim_boundary: This V3 task may establish only the full-primary-paper prior, fixed-maturity versus perpetual boundary, single-BTC spot-DRA transfer boundary, causal non-duplication and proof required for one later pre-outcome carry factor-definition audit. It cannot select or validate a source, endpoint, instrument, maturity, formula, threshold, lookback, cadence, side, exit, stop or DRA parameter; access outcomes; establish prediction, significance, fee-adjusted PnL, drawdown, fills, costs, capacity, candidate readiness, OOS value, deployability or Trading authority; or install, capture, register, activate or run the existing offline source plumbing.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: If a later separately preregistered equal-capital experiment shows that causal carry conditioning avoids adverse paths without excessive missed winners or concentration, maximum drawdown may improve; this primary-prior audit itself leaves drawdown MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A terminal primary-prior verdict supplies one independent mechanism conclusion while R1/R2 mature, prevents legacy funding or derivative-arbitrage logic from being repackaged as spot DRA alpha, and stops further carry plumbing unless the two-paper record supports exactly one bounded factor-definition audit.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Only a later independently frozen and validated matched-capital experiment could show positive fee-adjusted total PnL or drawdown improvement from a carry-conditioned DRA entry veto; this primary-prior audit has zero immediate performance effect.
